query: In HE Cluster 6 Innovation Actions, what is the average budget per partner in awarded projects? How many partners are in those IAs on average?
response:
Based on the analysis of 514 awarded Cluster 6 Innovation Action (IA) projects in Horizon Europe, here are the key statistics regarding consortium size and budget distribution:

### 1. Average Consortium Size

| Metric | Average | Median | Recommended Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Number of Partners** | **18.4 entities** | 17 entities | **15 – 21 partners** |

Cluster 6 IAs are demonstration-focused and generally require large, multidisciplinary consortia to cover all aspects of the value chain, from research (universities) to technology deployment (private companies) and end-user engagement (public bodies, farmers, NGOs).

### 2. Average Budget Per Partner

| Metric | Average | Median | Recommended Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Total EC Contribution** (per project) | **€5.7 Million** | €5.0 Million | €3.8M – €6.2M |
| **Budget Per Partner** | **€331,342** | €294,228 | €232k – €431k |

**Note on Funding Rate:** Innovation Actions (IA) typically have a funding rate of **70%** of eligible costs, except for non-profit organizations (universities, research institutes, NGOs, public bodies), which receive **100%** funding. The average per-partner budget reflects a blended rate due to the high participation of both research and private entities.

### 3. Consortium Composition Patterns

Cluster 6 IA projects show a strong focus on balancing research excellence with implementation capabilities. The typical partner distribution is:

| Organization Type | Average Partners/Project | Contribution Share |
|---|---|---|
| **Higher Education (HES)** | 5.2 | 32.3% |
| **Research Organizations (REC)** | 4.8 | 34.1% |
| **Private Companies (PRC)** | 4.9 | 20.4% |
| **Other (OTH)** (e.g., NGOs, associations) | 2.6 | 10.7% |
| **Public Bodies (PUB)** | 0.9 | 2.5% |

**Key Takeaway:** You should aim for a consortium of **16 to 21 partners** across **9 to 11 different EU/Associated Countries**, ensuring roughly equal participation from universities, research centers, and private companies to cover the demonstration and market exploitation aspects required by Innovation Actions.

### Recommended Next Steps

To ensure your project aligns with successful IAs, you should review the following resources:

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for Cluster 6
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
